headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advises University of New South Wales on setting up campus in Bengaluru

detail: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas has advised the University of New South Wales on establishing its first campus in India in Bengaluru. The University of New South Wales, holding a QS World Universities Ranking of 19 and the highest-ranked Australian University, has been granted a Certificate of Registration from the University Grants Commission. Ketaki Mehta, Aarushi Jain, Pooja Kapadia, Abe Abraham, Manasvini Raj, Yash Jain The CAM transaction team was led by Ketaki Mehta (Partner - GIFT City), with support from Jinisha Motwani (Senior Associate), Hridaykrishna Motwani (Senior Associate), and Sakshi Nathani (Associate).
